newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Moody's rates planned Acindar notes issue.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates planned Acindar notes issue.

text.p: Moody's Investor Service said Friday it assigned a B2 rating to a planned $100 million senior unsecured note issue by Argentina's steelmaker Acindar SA.
The rating also applies to Acindar's $125 million of outstanding senior unsecured floating rate notes due Nov 1998.
"The rating action reflects the potential for improvement in Acindar's business position from ongoing restructurings, continued rationalization and upgrade of production facilities," said Moody's.
This is the first time Moody's rates Acindar debt securities. The planned note issue will have a seven-year maturity.
